semiconductor_relevance: High — TRUMPF Hüttinger specializes in manufacturing plasma power supplies and microwave generators essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: TRUMPF Hüttinger is a leading provider of plasma power supplies and solid-state microwave generators, crucial for deposition and dry-etch processes in semiconductor manufacturing. With a focus on energy efficiency and high productivity, their products are designed to enhance uptime and coating quality.
capabilities: DC and RF plasma power supplies for deposition and etching processes

regional_presence.China: TRUMPF Hüttinger has a manufacturing presence in Taicang, China, and offers sales and service support in the region.
